_comment: Data-driven hOCG deck construction rules for the HoloHunter deck editor. Source of truth: DIC-943 official rule matrix. Only rules that the current card dataset can actually verify are enabled; unconfirmed rules (e.g. Bloom/Debut warnings that need Bloom-level data the dataset does not carry) are left disabled so they are NOT hardcoded as false positives. Update this file when the official rules or dataset change — do not hardcode rule values in TypeScript.

identity._comment: Same-card determination is strictly by card number (cardNumber). Same name / different number = different cards. Different version/rarity but same cardNumber = same card, copies combine.

restrictedCards._comment: Official restricted cards: max 1 copy. cardNumber -> limit. Keep in sync with official announcements (e.g. hBP07-101 restricted to 1 from 2026-06-19).

unlimitedCopyCards._comment: Cards printed with 'このカードはデッキに何枚でも入れられる' are exempt from the 4-copy limit. List their cardNumbers here as they are confirmed.
